introduction: South Dakota weatherization is performed by four Community Action programs serving different counties. Contact your county’s provider about the application and home review.
description: South Dakota weatherization is performed by four Community Action programs serving different counties. Contact your county’s provider about the application and home review.

sections.who: The provider checks household financial and home requirements. Ask for the current checklist.
sections.get: Possible work includes insulation, air sealing and heating-system improvements.
sections.docs:
• Household finances.
  • Home and utility information.
  • Owner permission records requested for the home.
sections.apply:
1. Find the county program

    Use the weatherization section and provider list.

  2. Complete local intake

    Ask about financial evidence, home requirements and any queue.

  3. Arrange assessment

    Discuss access and the work appropriate to the home.
sections.after: Keep provider details and ask about assessment findings or scheduling changes.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Weatherization services and county providers. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Weatherization provides improvements to the home’s energy efficiency.
The state lists possible repair, tune-up or replacement of nonfunctional heating systems.
The state identifies Community Action programs with county service areas.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
